faqs.a: Stamp Perk is a digital loyalty workspace: merchants run stamp cards, QR scan, CRM segments, coupons, automations, leaflets, and analytics; customers collect stamps, discover nearby shops, refer friends, and redeem rewards.
A paid trust badge. Merchants submit registration/PAN docs, admins review, then the business pays a Verified add-on. The badge boosts Discover ranking and shows on the public profile.
Yes — one loyalty card and limited stamps. Upgrade for unlimited cards, campaigns, and branches. Verified is a separate optional add-on.

faqs.q: Does the mobile app work offline?
faqs.a: Stamp and enroll actions can queue offline and sync when the connection returns.

faqs.q: How do customers find my shop?
faqs.a: Publish an active profile and appear in Discover. Verified merchants are ranked higher near the customer.

reviews.quote: The digital loyalty card system is simple to understand and makes collecting rewards more convenient than traditional stamp cards.
The QR scanner registers interactions in seconds, and the real-time analytics provide useful insights instantly.
Stamp Perk replaced our paper punch cards in minutes. It needs no extra hardware, and offline QR scanning is lightning-fast.
I switched to Stamp Perk last month, and my regulars love it. The analytics dashboard makes rewards and repeat visits easy to track.
I can manage my business and staff more easily, and the app has helped me a lot.
A useful app with a smooth, clean interface. Easy to use and highly recommended.
